visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a vibrant chicken salad garnished with red sauce and green lettuce on a wooden platter. (2) A person's hand is shown from a high angle, carefully slicing a raw chicken breast horizontally on a wooden cutting board to ensure even thickness for cooking. (3) The sliced chicken is placed into a clear glass bowl containing a liquid marinade; a hand thoroughly mixes the meat with spices like salt, garlic, and rice wine. (4) The chicken pieces are removed from the bowl and placed on a wooden surface where a white paper towel is used to firmly pat them dry. (5) A male chef in a professional white jacket appears against a green backdrop, speaking directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures and facial expressions. (6) A top-down shot shows liquid cooking oil being poured from a clear bottle in a swirling motion into a textured black frying pan. (7) The chicken breast pieces are placed into the hot pan, where they begin to sear and change color from pink to white under bright indoor lighting. (8) The chef returns to the frame, continuing his explanation with high energy and active hand movements in front of the studio setup. (9) Various ingredients like chopped onions and purees are poured into a small glass bowl and stirred with a wire whisk to create a dressing. (10) Transparent oil is added to the dressing mixture, and the whisking continues until the sauce is fully emulsified and consistent in texture. (11) The final plated salad is shown again in a tight close-up, with the prepared onion-based dressing drizzled over the sliced, cooked chicken.

(4) [Subtitle]: 抓醃完後放入冰箱冷藏15-20分鐘. (5) [Subtitle]: 醃完後用廚房紙巾把雞胸肉的水吸乾. (6) [Subtitle]: 雞胸肉煎至熟即可. (7) [Slogan]: 果醋 50ml, 洋蔥碎 30g, 蘋果泥 2大匙, 胡椒粉 半小匙, 鹽 半小匙, 初榨橄欖油 1匙. (8) [Subtitle]: 鹽風雞肉沙拉完成.
